en.sayed-ali-raza: for, by Allāh, I do not bow before you so that you may humiliate me, nor do I let loose the reins for you so that you may drive me away.
I swear by Allāh an oath wherein I, except the will of Allāh, shall so train myself that I will feel joyed if I get one loaf for eating, and be content with only salt to season it.
I shall let my eyes empty themselves of tears like the stream whose water has flown away.
